about.title: About Analyticatech
about.desc: Analyticatech is an independent firm founded by Martial Gninhi. I help leaders of small and mid-sized companies use AI and data in a concrete, measured and compliant way.
about.mission.title: My mission
about.mission.body: Make artificial intelligence useful and understandable for French SMEs and mid-sized companies: start from a real business problem, build a simple solution, and measure what it changes, with no unverifiable promises.
about.vision.title: My vision
about.vision.body: AI that serves teams rather than replacing them: every important decision stays human, every result is traceable, and data stays under the company's control.
about.values.title: My commitments
about.page.title: AI, explained simply, for SMEs and mid-sized companies.
about.page.desc: Background: web development, then data and BI (business intelligence), then a level 7 (RNCP) degree in artificial intelligence. Head office in Paris, office in Strasbourg, working across France.
